name: Malawi

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of black, red and green, with a red rising sun of 31 rays at the centre of the black stripe.
flag.symbolism: Black stands for the African people, red for the blood of the martyrs and green for nature; the rising sun represents the dawn of hope and freedom.

hook: Malawi has a red sun rising out of the black top stripe; Kenya has the same colours but a shield in the middle.
trivia: In 2010 Malawi switched to a red-black-green flag with a full white sun, but restored the original rising-sun design in 2012.
Lake Malawi is home to more fish species than any other lake, most of them cichlids.
